en.title: ea in seară (evening)
en.summary: The diphthong ea is found in the Romanian word seară.

sections.title: The sound ea
paragraphs: The letters ea sound like /e̯a/. Their main sound appears in (seară) /ˈse̯a.rə/, which means evening. These letters make only one sound in Romanian. You say them smoothly together in one single push of air.

sections.title: How to say ea
paragraphs: Start with your lips spread slightly as if smiling. Place your tongue high and forward in your mouth. Quickly drop your jaw and open your mouth wide. Let your tongue fall low and flat. Touch your throat with your hand to feel the steady vibration of your voice.

sections.title: Spelling of ea
paragraphs: The letters ea make the sound /e̯a/ in stressed parts of a word. You can hear this glide in (cafea) /kaˈfe̯a/. The two letters always stay in the exact same beat.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not turn these letters into two separate beats like the vowels in react. Do not pronounce them as the long vowel in tea. Glide smoothly from the first sound to the second without stopping.
